title: Medium healing mead

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Medium healing mead is a Swamp-tier consumable item fermented from Mead base: Medium healing.

sections.heading: Recipe
sections.text:
Mead base: Medium healing is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 10 Honey
• 4 Bloodbag
• 10 Raspberries
• 1 Dandelion
Six Medium healing meads are produced by fermenting the mead base for two in-game days.

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
Upon consumption, it restores 75 health over 10 seconds.
A 2-min cooldown is applied preventing consumption of another healing mead.
